notes: FinQA/TAT-DQA upstream ships a single split='test' with NO dev/holdout partition and NO gold chunk ids; 'context' is pre-extracted text, not the chunked corpus. Gold chunk/source refs and a family split must be authored before a real paired G5 eval (see docs/graph/G5-EVAL-REPORT.md).

Parquet corpora (ragbench-tests hotpotqa/tatqa/finqa, enterprise-rag-bench, financebench merged, xquad) are hashed by bytes but NOT parsed here: no pyarrow/fastparquet in the test venv and adding a dependency is out of scope. Their schemas are reported from their README/manifest, never guessed.

financebench-noncommercial-v1 is NON-COMMERCIAL licensed; do not use for a released product eval without a license review. enterprise-rag-bench-v1 is MIT and manifest-pinned (HF rev 69916e31...); its questions/gold are eval-only.
